headline: Papa pide que la paz no sea una fachada
content: Ciudad del Vaticano (AFP).— Unas 70 mil personas, eternos latinoamericanos, recibieron al papa tenido Francisco en la plaza de San Pedro en su  pierda navideña. Buenos días, felices fiesta, fueron las primeras palabras del Papa, desde el balcón de la basílica. El religioso, vestido con hábito blanco, pidi paz para los hombres en su primer mensaje Urbi et Orbii.La verdadera paz no es un equilibrio de fuerzas opuestas, dijo y añadió que «no es pura »fachada» que esconde luchas y divisiones. La paz es un compromiso diario, que se logra con el don de Dios».El Papa también rogó que «se ponga fin a la violencia en Siria y se garantice el acceso a la ayuda humanitaria».«Muchas [vidas] han destrozado en estos últimos tiempos el conflicto en Siria», generando odio y venganza», reconoci el Pontífice.Francisco imploró para que reinara la paz en diversos países africanos, entre ellos la República Central Africana, «a menudo olvidada por los hombres», y Sudán del Sur, donde las tensiones amenazaban la pacifica convivencia.El Papa pidió por las relaciones entre Israel y palestinos y que sanaran las heridas de Iraq.Dirigiéndose a los católicos y a los no creyentes, el religioso demandó pensar en los niños, que son las víctimas más vulnerables de las guerras, pero también en los ancianos, en las mujeres maltratadas, en los enfermos. «Las guerras destrozan vidas y causan muchísimo sufrimiento», expres.

headline: Afghanistan, Taliban launch projectiles but cause no personal damage
content: Attack embassy of US.KABUL (EFE). Two projectiles launched by the Taliban impacted in the United States Embassy, causing no casualties, reported diplomatic sources and insurgency representatives.The attack occurred around 06:40 AM yesterday, indicated in a statement the U.S. embassy in Afghanistan, which assured there were not any injuries.The note did not provide details about the nature of the two impacts in the American complex and limited itself to indicate that «the attack is being investigated».Meanwhile, the Taliban noted through their social media account that had fired four missiles against the U.S. embassy, although without victims.The Afghan conflict lives one of its most bloody moments since the invasion of the country led by the Americans who caused the fall of the Taliban regime twelve years ago. Foreign troops find themselves in the last phase of withdrawal process, which should conclude in 2014.

headline: North Koreas leader urges military readiness for combat amid tensions
content: SEOUL (EP).— North Korean Leader Kim Jong-un urged his soldiers during a visit to a military unit to prepare for battle amidst rising peninsula tensions following recent execution of his uncle and second-in-command, Jang Song-thaek, informed state agency KCNA.The young leader reportedly aged thirty instructed the military unit to strive maximally preparedness for war, always keeping in mind that conflicts could erupt unexpectedly according to reports.

headline: Egypt declares Muslim Brotherhood group terrorist organization
content: CAIRO (AFP/Reuters).— Egypt’s government formally designated the Muslim Brothers movement—the political party of ousted President Mohamed Morsi—as a terrorist entity.Ibrahim Munir, head of the Muslim Brothers called upon supporters to continue protests against current authorities labeling such decision invalid.

headline: Iraq church bombing kills over 38 people during Christmas mass
content: More than 38 dead and 70 injured left behind after twin bombings targeted Christian community within Baghdad district.Al-Doura witnessed car bombs detonating near Virgin Mary Church where attendees exited post-mass celebrations resulting approximately 27 fatalities alongside 56 wounded.Additionally three more explosives exploded within nearby market area frequented largely by Christians leading further eleven deaths plus fourteen injuries.Market suffered extensive property damages while minority Christian population represents slightly less than 3 percent nationwide.Christians reduced holiday festivities due violence spike throughout year altering traditional service durations.No groups claimed responsibility yet likely perpetrators include Islamic State of Iraq linked to Al-Qaeda.

headline: Young woman rescued after weeks-long abduction and assault
content: NEW DELHI (EFE). Police saved a seventeen-year-old girl abducted and assaulted continuously across fortnight by lawyer she approached seeking document certification, revealed Indian television channel NDTV.Case unfolded merely fifteen meters away from victim’s residence neighbor alerted police hearing cries prompting immediate intervention.Arrest followed capturing suspect estimated forty-years old.

headline: Desgracias en Navidad. Dos muertes y varios incendios debido a la explosión de pirotécnicos
content: El uso de pirotécnicos nuevamente oscureció la celebración de la Navidad. Un joven y un adulto murieron a consecuencia de la explosión de estos artefactos. Las víctimas mortales incluyen a un menor de inicial M. A. B., de 16 años, quien sufrió múltiples lesiones después de que explotasen diversos dispositivos pirotécnicos llevados en su mochila. Testigos cercanos también resultaron gravemente lesionados. Incidentes adicionales involucraron incendios significativos en varias áreas urbanas.

headline: Análisis de los Bomberos: Sería peor en Año Nuevo
content: Durante la temporada festiva, aproximadamente 500 bomberos trabajaron continuamente para manejar diversas emergencias.
